description: A business rule that cannot be described with the standard elements of the information model. A rule must restrict at least 1 element.

elementid.description: unique ID (over whole model) of the business rule for reference purposes

name.description: name for textual references of the busiess rule

description.description: Explanation of the rule, its application and consequenses.

restrictedelements.description: Elements that are restricted by this business rule.

rule.description: Expression, rule, formula stating how the linked elements depend on each other.

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of this element, added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.

examples: The start date must be less than the end date.
A mixture must consist of at least 2 substances.
Telephone number or e-mail address (or both) must be filled in for a person.

BusinessRuleId.description: typed ID unique over all businessrules in this schema
